Here you can find all my educational content:

  • My book: Detailing my investment strategy. I am currently working on the 2nd edition, so I am open to feedback!

  • Education: Articles range from how to read financial statements to what ROIC is and how to use it. You can find more educational content in my LinkedIn newsletter “Monthly Investing Fundamentals”.

  • Investment Philosophy: In the Weeklies, I have shared my investment philosophy. In this section, I have tried to consolidate that philosophy in a digestible way.

  • Udemy course - “Stock Investing Masterclass - Invest like the professionals”: I created this course with a friend back in 2019. If you are a paid subscriber, just send me a note and I will grant you access.

  • Monte Carlo Simulator add-on for Google Sheets.

The Most Boring Stock Investment Book You’ll Ever Read

About the Book

This isn't your typical finance book filled with buzzwords and overnight millionaire schemes. The Most Boring Stock Investment Book You'll Ever Read strips away the fluff and teaches you how real investing works. From analyzing financial statements to identifying catalysts and crafting your own valuation models, this book gives you a complete blueprint to long-term investing success.

Think of it as a practical guide for people who want to do the work, not chase the hype.

What You'll Learn

  • Why boring, underfollowed companies often outperform the market

  • How to evaluate management, calculate return on capital, and assess industry dynamics

  • How to build and track valuation models like a pro

  • When to buy, how to set a price target, and when to exit

  • The six key pillars of every great investment

  • Real-world investment cases including , and

This book is ideal for

  • Long-term investors who want a repeatable system

  • Finance students and DIY investors

  • Readers tired of get-rich-quick trading nonsense

Author Background

George Atuan, CFA, is the founder of Beating The Tide, an investment newsletter with a proven track record of outperforming the S&P 500 since 2011.

His approach draws from his diverse experience as an engineer, corporate strategist, and buy-side investment analyst. With +18 years of hands-on investing, his system is built on simplicity, skepticism, and rigorous analysis.
